sources.locator: Act 233/1995 sections 95-104; verify effective consolidation at activation
Act 40/1964, capacity, representation and nonordinary property acts

requirements.expected: Duplicate delivery is a no-op; old release cannot undo a newer effect; conflicting equal revisions fail.
Authenticated transport alone does not establish competent issuer or the correct debtor; ambiguity requires review.
Retain originals and service receipt; issued, served, known and applied timestamps remain distinct.
A response contains only authorized fields from the required snapshot and records what was sent.
Prohibited customer notice is suppressed while permitted notices retain their own deadline.
Releasing one legal effect does not release another; payment TTL and payment cover release cannot cancel attachment.
Concurrent reservations across accounts cannot exceed the order-wide allocation budget or count the same funds twice.
Legal allocation uses funded money only and never consumes an unused arranged overdraft.
Evaluate self-capacity, representative scope and required consent independently; a guardian does not own the funds.
A protected-funds transaction must satisfy both funds protection and the acting persons legal authority.
All instructed value sinks invoke applicable production controls; staff release and direct booking cannot bypass them.
Crash and retry preserve the atomic state/outbox boundary; uncertain remittance is reconciled before retry.
A stale inbox or projection produces an explicit unavailable result, never a claim that no legal order exists.
Each decision records its pack revision; effective law changes apply to existing cases where transition rules require.
The applicable fixed exemption is not multiplied across the debtors accounts; amount is effective-dated pack data.
Qualifying income exemption uses the legally relevant notification and evidence, not a guessed payment description.
Equal statutory rank for orders received on the same day produces the required proportional allocation and rounding.
Distinguish a stay retaining attachment from a stay lifting it; suspension of remittance is not automatically release.
A representative cannot perform a nonordinary property act without the legally required court approval.
